basic.description:
{Basic Necromancy}

Raises up to 10% of defeated living creatures as Skeletons, limited by their health. With the Cloak of the Undead King: Ghouls.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Necromancy}

Raises up to 20% of defeated living creatures as Skeleton Warriors, limited by their health. With the Cloak of the Undead King: Specters.

expert.description:
{Expert Necromancy}

Raises up to 30% of defeated living creatures as Skeleton Knights, limited by their health. With the Cloak of the Undead King: Lich Kings.
